hooks.command: sh -c '[ -z "$PR_REVIEW_CHILD" ] || exit 0; p=$(cat); case "$p" in *"gh pr create"*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; url=$(printf "%s" "$p" | jq -r ".tool_response | tostring" | grep -oE "https://github[.]com/[^/ ]+/[^/ ]+/pull/[0-9]+" | head -1); [ -n "$url" ] || exit 0; cd "$(printf "%s" "$p" | jq -r .cwd)" || exit 0; n=$(printf "%s" "$url" | cut -d/ -f4-7 | sed "s|/pull/|#|"); f="$HOME/.cache/pr-review/$(printf "%s" "$url" | cut -d/ -f4-7 | tr / -).md"; mkdir -p "${f%/*}"; set --; r="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/REVIEW.md"; if [ -f "$r" ]; then d=$(mktemp -d) && cp "$r" "$d/CLAUDE.md" && set -- --add-dir "$d"; fi; (c=$(gh pr view "$url" --json headRefOid -q .headRefOid 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-7); PR_REVIEW_CHILD=1 CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUDE_MD=1 claude -p "/code-review xhigh $url" -n "PR review $n${c:+ @ $c}" --setting-sources user --permission-mode auto "$@" >"$f" 2>&1; [ -z "$d" ] || rm -rf "$d"; osascript -e "display notification \"Findings saved to $f\" with title \"Review finished\"") </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &'
